note: Provenance-based resolution. Removes the universal default: a node resolves its form through provenance -> producing toolkit -> that toolkit's visual binding -> the archetype declared for node.role_axis / semantic_type. There is NO default_authority that dresses every node as a citizen. A node with no producing-toolkit binding renders as the honest bare-presence fallback (a recognizably 'unbound' point), never a fabricated identity and never a defaulted citizen. The citizen-energy catalog is DEMOTED to one toolkit binding among others. v0 is kept only until the Rust VisualPolicy authority (crates/universe-assets/src/visual.rs) migrates to this shape; then v0 is deleted.

resolution.provenance_toolkit_binding: node.provenance -> producing toolkit -> registered visual binding -> archetype for (role_axis, semantic_type).
resolution.fallback_presence: A node whose producing toolkit declares no binding for its config renders as the shared bare-presence point: an explicit, recognizable 'unbound' shell.
forbidden: a universal default_authority that dresses every node the same
resolving form by LOD residency alone with no provenance
substituting a citizen/energy form for a node produced by a different toolkit

toolkit_bindings.justification: The underground toolkit dresses its produced roles in its own infrastructure grammar (vault, well, station, junction, reservoir, manhole, sealed hatch). Appearance is carried AS a member of the construct, not a standalone file.
The Sky toolkit dresses any authored atom program as a luminous constellation (star + constellation lines), carried AS a member of the construct.
The citizen-energy kit dresses an actor as the energy semi-humanoid. DEMOTED from universal default to one toolkit binding; applies only to nodes whose provenance is the citizen-energy toolkit.

fallback_presence.note: No toolkit binding = a bare, unglowing presence point. Recognizably unbound, not a defaulted body.

epistemic_modulation.note: Shared honesty grammar, reused by every toolkit binding; step 3 drives it from measurement. Carried over unchanged from v0.
